lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd2ZnSe4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell containing 28 atoms (Nd8Zn4Se16) across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Nd environments coordinated by four Se neighbors, and 10-vertex Zn environments with mixed Se and Zn neighbors. The tetrahedral Nd polyhedra share corners with one another and with 10-vertex Zn polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
